title: The Wasserstein Bipolarization Index: A New Measure of Public Opinion Polarization, with an Application to Cross-Country Attitudes toward COVID-19 Vaccination Mandates.
reasoning: The paper is a statistical and methodological study focused on developing a new measure for polarization (the Wasserstein Bipolarization Index). While it applies this measure to public opinion data regarding COVID-19 vaccination mandates, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as its primary focus.
